verdict.rationale: Cake exposes an MCP server so external AI assistants (Claude, Codex, Cursor) can query live cap table data (shareholders, option pool, vesting, SAFEs) in plain English, effectively delivering AI-generated insights from the user's data. However this relies on connecting an external AI client rather than a native in-product AI feature, and there's no evidence of proactive suggestions or recommendations, only Q&A-style answers. Missing for 10: native in-app AI assistant/insights UI, proactive suggestion generation, independent corroboration of MCP usage quality.
